correctness.rationale: The proof derives the exact binary-tree Littlestone recurrence D(v)=max_U[1+min(D(v&Q(U)),D(v\Q(U)))] over proper nonempty splits, with D(singleton)=0. The actual verify_all.cpp iterates every one of 2^21-1 nonempty edge masks and all 128 vertex queries in induction order; the independent rewritten C++ solver exhaustively confirmed exactly 147 failures, all 16-edge masks of dimension 3. An independent constructive set comparison verifies exactly 42 K6-with-leaf and 105 K6-edge-subdivisions, with no 8/8 query split. Isolated-vertex embedding settles <=6 vertices. Exhaustive finite verification is a complete argument for <=7, not beyond.
